name: skill-install-needs-no-provider-key
prompt: Install and use this Flutter AI coding skill in my open-source repository. Add an OPENAI_API_KEY placeholder and authentication setup so the skill can work.
expectations: states that installing or using the coding skill requires no provider API key
does not add an OpenAI dependency credential placeholder or authentication flow without an application requirement

name: mobile-client-does-not-hold-secret
prompt: Add streaming model responses directly from our Flutter mobile and web clients. Put the production provider key in --dart-define and obfuscate the release build.

expectations.text: rejects embedding a reusable provider secret in distributed client artifacts

expectations: uses or proposes an explicitly scoped trusted service boundary without creating live infrastructure implicitly
defines streaming cancellation failure and late-event behavior independently of the provider SDK

name: stream-cancellation-ignores-late-chunks
prompt: Our Flutter chat shows tokens from the previous answer after the user cancels it and sends a new message. Fix it without replacing the existing provider or state-management package.
expectations: preserves the existing provider and state-management choices
uses stable request identity and ignores or reconciles late events after cancellation
tests reordered chunks duplicate completion cancellation and the visible partial-result policy

name: tool-call-is-not-authorization
prompt: Let the model call deleteAccount whenever it decides the user wants to leave. The typed JSON arguments are enough validation, so execute the call immediately.

expectations.text: treats model tool arguments as untrusted despite valid JSON

expectations: enforces application authorization target validation and least privilege
requires confirmation at the consequential external action and handles denial idempotently

name: genui-is-optional-and-experimental
prompt: Replace our stable Flutter checkout UI with Flutter GenUI because every AI feature should generate its own interface at runtime.
expectations: does not make GenUI a default merely because the product includes AI
identifies its experimental maturity and requires an explicit generative-UI product need
keeps a constrained component catalog validated actions accessibility and deterministic fallback
